scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @zerocloud/shared build && concurrently -k -n web,signal -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @zerocloud/web dev" "pnpm --filter @zerocloud/signal dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zerocloud/shared build && pnpm --filter @zerocloud/signal build && pnpm --filter @zerocloud/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @zerocloud/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @zerocloud/signal typecheck && pnpm --filter @zerocloud/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @zerocloud/shared test && pnpm --filter @zerocloud/shared build && pnpm --filter @zerocloud/web test
